findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment:
750-540 All Category II facilities must have at least one full-time Licensed Food Service Sanitation Manager employed at the facility to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide at least one fulltime Food Service Sanitation Manager.

Facility prior to the beginning of the year was a low risk facility (not requiring a food manager) and after discussing with management will reduce back to a low risk facility. No food manager will be needed.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed a garden hose used at the three compartment sink. Replace the hose with a food grade hose (typically white or yellow). If the hose is cut below the flood rim line, make sure to place a vacuum breaker on the sink.
750-650b Equipment shall be designed to prevent cross-contamination of food or food contact surfaces by lubricants that it may require. Only food safe lubricants shall be used on equipment on or within food-contact surfaces.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Counter behind hand sink has some cracks. 750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition. Seal counter with silicone or replace.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment: Wet cloth used for wiping is stored on the bar top. 750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses. Store cloths in sanitizer between uses so that viruses and bacteria are destroyed.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment: Hot dog roller observed on the end of the bar. 750-1350c Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items. Remove hot dog roller.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed an accumulation of food and mold inside the drink dispensers.
750-800d The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.
*Clean and sanitize the drink dispensers at the bar.

findings.title: Cross-connections, back-siphonage, back-flow prevented
findings.comment:
Observed a hose attached to the 3-compartment sink.
750-1080 A hose shall not be attached to a faucet unless a backflow prevention device is installed. 
*Remove the hose.  Install a backflow prevention device.  Corrected.

findings.title: Outside storage area clean, enclosure properly constructed
findings.comment:
Repeat:  The dumpster is located on gravel and dirt.
75-1140 Garbage and refuse containers shall be in good repair and stored on or above concrete or asphalt.
*Located the dumpster on concrete or asphalt.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
The plexiglass over the ice bin is cut and chipped on corner.
750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Absence of chemical test kit to check sanitizer in the 3 compartment sink.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.comment:
REPEAT VIOLATION++ Observed common blue towel stored at the bar handwashing sink.
750-1120e A supply of soap and and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.comment:

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
(REPEAT VIOLATION) Floor in the walkin cooler with loose tile and missing tile.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
